funds_data.description: The underlying index is designed to track the performance of the top 60 growth stocks in the S&P MidCap 400® Index with relatively high quality and value composite scores, which are computed pursuant to the index methodology. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the components of the underlying index and in derivatives and other investments that have economic characteristics similar to the components of the underlying index.
